conditions: agents are trained via deep reinforcement learning (e.g., DQN, Rainbow)

exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported system, task (Hanabi), population (DQN/Rainbow agents), and experimental conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Augmentation of the action for task performance, faster training
